column1: # GOLDEN2-LIKE paralogs used in the photosynthesis figure (fig_photo_etc,
# panels C and D) of the BioFlux manuscript.
# arabidopsis_gene / arabidopsis_name / psi / tag record the PlantSEED ortholog
# call. tag O means OrthoFinder called the pair orthologous, which is accepted
# regardless of identity -- note all four PSI values fall below the monocot
# (0.55) and eudicot (0.60) thresholds, so none would have been accepted on
# identity alone.
# paper_label is the name the manuscript uses, and for Sorghum it deliberately
# does NOT follow the Arabidopsis assignment. The slots were swapped on
# 2026-08-04 so that SbGLK1 is the gene in the grass GLK1 clade
# (Sobic.010G096300, which clusters with rice Os06g24070).
# Why the two numberings disagree, per the gene tree (OG0003894, files beside
# this one): the grass and eudicot GLK duplications are INDEPENDENT. The tree
# recovers two grass clades,
# and, on the other side of the monocot/eudicot split, AT2G20570 and AT5G44190
# as a sister pair -- the two Arabidopsis GLKs are each other's closest
# relatives, not the closest relatives of either grass clade. Potri.007G136901
# and Potri.017G015800 are likewise a sister pair, which is the tree-level
# statement of the "indistinguishable recent duplication" note below.
# So there is no 1:1 orthologous correspondence to be had between the grass
# GLK1/GLK2 and the Arabidopsis GLK1/GLK2. Neither Arabidopsis gene is
# specifically related to grass clade A; both share the same last common
# ancestor with both grass clades. That is why an Arabidopsis-derived label
# cannot name a grass paralog at all -- not because the labels come out crossed,
# but because the mapping does not exist.
# The paper's assignment is confirmed by the tree: Sobic.010G096300, which the
# manuscript calls SbGLK1, is the gene that co-clusters with rice Os06g24070.
# Caveat on the deep topology: the resolved tree places the grass clade outside
# Amborella, which is not species-tree congruent, so the deepest splits in this
# gene tree should not be read as phylogeny. The within-grass and
# within-eudicot groupings used above are the shallow, well-supported part.
# READ THE psi COLUMN WITH CARE -- it is not the evidence for that. The source
# tables (data/orthologs/Ath-{Sbi,Ptr}-Orthologs.tsv) are a fully connected 2x2:
# every Arabidopsis GLK hits every species GLK, and the scores are nearly flat.
# "exclusive" in this filename means a 1:1 assignment was imposed on that graph.
# For Sorghum the two possible assignments tie exactly (0.42+0.38 = 0.41+0.39 =
# 0.80), so which one ended up here is arbitrary -- the other one would have
# paired AtGLK2 with Sobic.003G002600 and made the numbering agree. For Poplar
# the four scores are 0.48/0.48/0.47/0.47, indistinguishable, which is the same
# thing seen from the other side of the A/B pair below.
# So the clade assignment rests on the OG0003894 gene tree and the grass
# literature, not on anything in this table.
# Gene tree provenance
# OrthoFinder reference run, 15 species, 2021-05-26:
#   /scratch1/seaver/OrthoFinder_Reference/OrthoFinder/Results_May26
# Orthogroup OG0003894 holds all six focal GLKs plus maize, rice, Brachypodium,
# Amborella, Spirodela, citrus, apple, tomato and soybean copies. Extracted
# beside this file as:
#   OG0003894_resolved_gene_tree.txt   Resolved_Gene_Trees/ (used above)
#   OG0003894_gene_tree.txt            Gene_Trees/ (unresolved)
#   OG0003894_msa.fa                   MultipleSequenceAlignments/
#   OG0003894_sequences.fa             Orthogroup_Sequences/
#   OG0003894_members.tsv              the Orthogroups.tsv row, one line/species
# The digits are crossed because GLK1 and GLK2 were numbered independently in
# the two lineages -- in Arabidopsis, and in the grasses via maize G2/ZmGLK1 and
# rice OsGLK1/OsGLK2 -- before the relationships across the monocot/eudicot split
# were resolved. The numbers are historical nomenclature, not a claim of
# orthology, and they do not correspond between lineages.
# The manuscript follows the grass numbering because the C3/C4
# sub-functionalization argument (Wang et al., 2012) is about the grass clades:
# it is the bundle-sheath/mesophyll-compartmentalized grass GLK1 that the
# Pearson r of +0.86 in the text refers to.
# Poplar's two copies are an indistinguishable recent Salicaceae whole-genome
# duplication pair and cannot be separated into GLK1 and GLK2, so the manuscript
# labels them A and B.
# Authoritative source for the mapping: CONFIG.glk_orthologs in
# Paper_Figures/fig_photo_etc.py of the companion gradient-descent repository.
arabidopsis_gene
